gloss: moody person; someone whose mood changes easily

definitions.gloss: moody person; someone whose mood changes easily
definitions.explanation: a person whose feelings and attitudes fluctuate frequently and unpredictably

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気分屋|きぶんや}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧にくい。
examples.english: He's moody, so he's hard to deal with.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{気分屋|きぶんや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm having trouble because my boss is moody.

examples.japanese: {気分屋|きぶんや}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}したい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I want to fix my moody personality.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧ (mood) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (person suffix indicating a tendency)

USAGE:
Often has a slightly negative connotation, implying that the person is difficult to deal with because their behavior depends on their mood. Can be used self-deprecatingly.

SIMILAR PATTERNS WITH {屋|や}:
- {恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ - shy person
- {寂|さび}し⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ - person who easily gets lonely
- {怖|こわ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ - timid/easily scared person
- ⟦{頑張|がんば}り→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ - hard worker

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a noun or as a na-adjective: {気分屋|きぶんや}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧
